name: Colour
description: Sets up a baseline grade. Detect cameras lists the cameras in the active sequence with one of your Lumetri presets (LUT) for each. Apply baseline grade makes "<name> GRADED TOOLKIT COPY" where every video clip has a Lumetri called "Adjustments" on top and the camera's LUT Lumetri under it, so you grade by selecting Adjustments. Make LUT presets turns a folder of .cube files into presets to import. The open sequence is not changed; nothing is saved.

actions.label: Apply baseline grade
actions.confirm: Make a graded copy of this sequence? Premiere gets a new sequence "<name> GRADED TOOLKIT COPY" in which every video clip has a Lumetri called "Adjustments" on top and its camera's LUT Lumetri under it (clips that already have a LUT keep theirs). The open sequence is not changed; nothing is saved.

prompts.title: Choose the folder with your LUTs
prompts.explain:
Make LUT presets

Every .cube LUT in the folder you choose (and its subfolders) becomes a Lumetri preset with the same name, with the LUT loaded on the Creative tab's Look, plus a plain "Adjustments" preset. They are written to one preset file in PenyToolkit-scratch/colour; nothing in Premiere changes until you import that file (Effects panel menu > Import Presets…).
